findings: Formation.type: change "mixed" to "phonosemantic" for the described 雞 compound (with an earlier pictographic stage); the current account identifies 隹/鳥 as the bird-category element and 奚 as phonetic, so "mixed" obscures the supported formation. Cite the early pictograph-to-compound account and the compound analyses.

Learner.overview: replace "developed into a compound" with a qualified construction such as "is analyzed in later forms as a compound". The dossier supports that interpretation but does not establish a fully dated sequence from the early picture to the compound; the current wording overstates chronology.

Learner.components[3] and takeaway: clarify that 鳮 is an attested simplified-style variant associated with 雞 and listed in the 1956 scheme as 鳮（雞）, while the precise route to 鸡 is undocumented. Calling 鳮 a form "associated with 雞" and then saying 鸡 is related through 鳮 can read as a demonstrated direct derivation; preserve the stated uncertainty about the graphic steps.
